name: Singapore
weather: Tropical — hot and humid year-round with occasional showers
tipping: Not expected — service charge usually included in bills
transportation: MRT (Mass Rapid Transit), buses, Grab taxis, walking
highlights: Marina Bay Sands — iconic rooftop infinity pool and skyline views
Gardens by the Bay — futuristic Supertree Grove light show at night
Hawker Centre food culture — 50+ dishes under one roof from $2
Sentosa Island — beaches, Universal Studios, cable car rides
